source_caption:
🎥🎬: MobLand (2025)

A ruthless London crime family finds its power and influence threatened when a long-simmering conflict with a rival syndicate erupts into an all-out war. At the centre of the chaos is Harry Da Souza, a highly skilled fixer caught between powerful crime bosses, family loyalties, and dangerous secrets.

As violence spreads through London’s criminal underworld, Harry is forced to navigate betrayals, shifting alliances, and escalating threats while protecting the people closest to him. Every move brings him deeper into a deadly power struggle where loyalty can change in an instant.

With rival families fighting for control, Harry must decide how far he is willing to go to protect his own interests. As the war reaches its breaking point, the consequences of the choices made by both families threaten to destroy everything they have built.

source_details.synopsis: MobLand is a crime drama television series created by Ronan Bennett for Paramount+. The series stars Tom Hardy as Harry Da Souza, Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan and Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan. Additional main characters include Kevin Harrigan (Paddy Considine), Jan Da Souza (Joanne Froggatt), Isabella Harrigan (Lara Pulver), Eddie Harrigan (Anson Boon), and Seraphina Harrigan (Mandeep Dhillon). Guy Ritchie, Anthony Byrne, Daniel Syrkin, and Lawrence Gough serve as directors. Jez Butterworth and Bennett are credited with writing all ten episodes of the first season.
